key_insight: TraceFEM provides provable error control for the spatial discretization of coupled surface Stokes–Cahn–Hilliard flow, assuming no geometric error.
engineering_relevance: The analysis supports reliable finite element simulation of coupled fluid flow and phase separation on surfaces.
method: Use TraceFEM with stabilization that filters out Killing vector fields.
Establish discrete inf-sup equivalence for trace Taylor–Hood pairs.
Introduce p-dependent normal-derivative stabilization to derive approximation, inverse, and solution-error estimates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports energy- and L²-norm error estimates, phase-variable L∞ estimates on two-dimensional surfaces, and corroborating numerical experiments.
watch_item: The analysis assumes exact geometry and discretizes space only, so geometric approximation and time-integration errors require separate assessment.
paper_title: Analysis of TraceFEM for the Surface Stokes-Cahn-Hilliard Model
